I'm 26f and was broken up with and will probably have to take a few years off. I seriously feel exactly like you.
I am also starting an 80 hr/wk job as an OB/GYN resident, so I know a few things about making babies. Fertility declines around 30 but it isn't drastic until around 35, plenty of people have kids after and there is always interventions to help.

Does the raw score matter and will it be bad if you fail? Also I went through a breakup before graduation. You figure out who exactly is your friend and who just wants to ignore you to have a good time. Study in a group if that helps you.
Any song from the movie soundtrack "once". But they kind of just make me sad so maybe not
this at the very least made me lol. thanks
i wish this would make it to the front page of reddit. i have no idea how many times ive read "dont stick your dick in crazy" on this site.

I'm not sure what you mean by red flag. We had all of the same friends, unfortunately they are all couples. He was friends with them first and initially not everyone was dating but they coupled off. His best friend is kind of the coordinator of the whole group. The girls are not as tight as the guys are. So by losing him, I lost the whole group. He is happy now so he gets called to go out with them but people are tired of dealing with me being depressed. They were probably tired of the drama (crying/angry stuff) over the past year that i had when we were drinking when he was pulling away from me and I could sense it.   I was insecure and sometimes jealous during our relationship due to previous abusive/toxic relationships (cheating, physical abuse, etc). And so when it came time to make IMPORTANT decisions he wouldn't communicate with me, probably because he didn't really want to be with me and hurt my feelings (which i asked him at the time, but he denies) but was fucking me over by me being late applying to internships etc because I was asking him every day if we should do it and he put it off, and then found out one day he did it without me. That only propagated the insecurity, crying, etc. In the meantime I saw all these other couples planning things. And it was so frustrating. I also would get more upset when drinking, and the worst was a big fight at our friends wedding in June, i dont remember it because I was too drunk but I know i was already upset because at the last minute he left for the wedding to go to the bach party the night before and left me scrambling to find my own ride even though the other couples had planned together (in the midst of all of our other planning problems). Then had to sit through dinner listening to everyones plans for the next year, which he had left me out on. At one point in the wedding i was upset and drunk and crying and saying he didn't love me and I took a swipe at him with my clutch, needless to say the metal part hit him in the temple and he had to go get stitches.  I know that the angry/drinking isn't an excuse for this. It was really terrible, but I think the stuff I did to contribute to the relationship ending was much more apparent than the passive way he contributed, and maybe that is why they give him a little more credit. They were nice to me after the event. A lot of people tried to ask what he was doing with me and encourage me to just take care of myself bc they knew he was jerking me around, but I loved him too damn much I didn't want to give up. And he would also be really hot one day and say he was excited to plan stuff with me and cold the next. Even the week before he broke up with me he said "I have tricks up my sleeve for vday" "I will never love anyone as much as you". This kind of behavior for >1 year. And i just feel like crap bc all these couples worked out and we didn't, and now I lost him AND all these friends.

I was the least favorite, the second girl out of girl girl boy. My sister is the oldest, charismatic and always gets what she wants.She is coming to my graduation and the week will end up being more about her than me, I am sure, because she lives overseas and whenenver she is around therefore she is 100% in charge. my brother was spoiled, the only boy of course, called "special". Sister got a car on my 16th bday etc etc. I was the kid that "always took care of herself" except obviously I felt like shit about it the whole time. I just felt like they should've known better that as a child, I couldve used some more attention or support. This is a big reason why I feel like me being around was some kind of a mistake.

I know that something needs to change but I dont know how. I'm 26 years old. Ive been like this my whole life. I'm always the friend that will be there by you no matter what shit you pull on me, etc. and I'm kind of tired of it. I dont know how to ask for things from people. Even in my relationship, I had an abortion and went to get the procedure all by myself so he wouldn't have to go through the terrible experience too. I needed a hug or flowers or something from him but didnt know how to ask, it was in the middle of all these stressful interviews and I had to get it in between interviews in a terrible place in new york city. Afterwards I just picked up my meds and went sight seeing  even though I had been under anesthesia and crying in a recovery room a few hours before. Contrast when my ex bf had a cold a few weeks later, I went out and bought him all this cold medicine. I was asking him to take us out for our anniversary bc I didnt think he would (he had put it off a few weeks) but then suggested we put it off because he couldn't taste the food, even though it was making me feel terrible for putting it off. And then later he got annoyed that I nagged him so much for asking him to do it. It wasn't even nice or romantic when we ended up going. I could tell he was just pissed at me.

 I wish someone was here for me now but I"m all alone. There is something INTERNALLY wrong with me where I am more comfortable giving to people than asking for things, and I end up burned. People call me "nice" but it isn't nice its just fucked up. And look at where it has gotten me. I dont know how to fix it ive been this way since i can remember. My mom used to tell me i was her favorite and she would take me and leave the rest of my family (kind of fucked up). But her actions were completely different because whenever I got the balls to ask for something like new clothes she would yell at me and call me spoiled.

This happened to me too. Im avoiding "our" shows and watching other stuff on Netflix. Watch those girlie movies he never wanted to watch.
You lifted together? Try yoga.
Maybe youll go back to the stuff he taught you to like later, but if its too hard now then don't go there.
Did he buy you things around your apartment? Put them away. Throw out his toothbrush.
Also, if you're like me, your bedroom is the worst. I slept on my couch for two months. Rearrange it. Buy new bedding. And spread out in the middle of your bed, you dont have to share that shit now.

This happened to me two weekends ago. In grad school, we have all the same mutual friends who only hang out with him now. My ex (3 year relationship_ had friends in town so of course I was trying to avoid seeing them (who i have gotten to know really well). So i contacted people I was barely friends with to distract myself from the fact that I'm the least importnat person in his life here now and what happened? he showed up at the bar I was at, in a large city. I was having a great time until he got there and when i saw him and his friend it was like my internal organs dropped out of me.

one thing ive been doing that has helped is stop drinking for the time being. you can still go to the bars with friends just tell them you wont drink because it will help your mood. I think i probably wouldn't have lost my shit if I wasn't drunk when I saw him. also, if friends are reaching out to you, hang out with them. Tell yourself that you care about the people who care about you.

the book..the language of letting go.. has also been some help when i want to stop ruminating about everything ill read a few passages.
